SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How are members of the Children's Government chosen? (1 mark)
   A. By buying votes
   B. By luck at a market
   C. By election
   D. By force

2. What is a resource? (1 mark)
   A. A game
   B. A school rule
   C. Something we can use to meet our needs and earn a living
   D. A kind of weather

3. Which of these is a child right? (1 mark)
   A. To work in a quarry
   B. To be beaten
   C. To go to school
   D. To be married early

4. Which physical feature helps people to catch fish? (1 mark)
   A. A plain
   B. A hill
   C. A lake
   D. A plateau

5. Which of these can be a school enterprise project? (1 mark)
   A. A vegetable garden
   B. A robbery
   C. A war
   D. Bullying

6. How do religious leaders help the community? (1 mark)
   A. They sell food
   B. They drive buses
   C. They teach values and comfort people
   D. They repair roads

7. Which of these is a quality of a good citizen in school? (1 mark)
   A. Honesty
   B. Bullying
   C. Laziness
   D. Cheating

8. Which minister would organise a football match between classes? (1 mark)
   A. Environment
   B. Sports and games
   C. Health
   D. Library

9. Which season is best for planting most crops? (1 mark)
   A. Dry season
   B. Cold season
   C. Rainy season
   D. Hot season

10. Which drink is likely to sell more during the hot season? (1 mark)
   A. Hot tea
   B. Cold drinks
   C. Hot porridge
   D. Hot soup

11. What should you do if you break a school rule? (1 mark)
   A. Blame others
   B. Say sorry and accept fair guidance
   C. Run away
   D. Hide it

12. Who keeps the money and records it in a school project? (1 mark)
   A. The treasurer
   B. The safety officer
   C. The visitor
   D. The gatekeeper

13. Which pattern describes people living along a road or river in a line? (1 mark)
   A. Circular
   B. Clustered
   C. Linear
   D. Scattered

14. What do traders do for farmers? (1 mark)
   A. Build their houses
   B. Teach their children
   C. Buy their crops and take them to markets
   D. Grow their crops

15. Who usually passes traditional culture on to children? (1 mark)
   A. Only strangers
   B. Parents, grandparents and elders
   C. Machines
   D. Only shops

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Draw a compass rose and label the four cardinal points. (3 marks)

17. Give two reasons why we need to know the location of our county. (2 marks)

18. Explain three elements of democracy and give an example of each in school. (5 marks)

19. Explain the meaning of an economic activity and give two examples. (3 marks)

20. What is a majority? (2 marks)
pages.answers:
SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — By election
   Pupils vote for their leaders.

2. C — Something we can use to meet our needs and earn a living
   Resources include land, water, minerals and people's skills.

3. C — To go to school
   Children have the right to education.

4. C — A lake
   People fish in lakes, rivers and the ocean.

5. A — A vegetable garden
   A garden can be run safely by pupils.

6. C — They teach values and comfort people
   Religious leaders teach good values and care for people.

7. A — Honesty
   Honesty is a positive quality.

8. B — Sports and games
   Sports leaders organise games.

9. C — Rainy season
   Seeds need rain water to germinate and grow.

10. B — Cold drinks
   People are thirsty and feel hot, so they buy cold drinks.

11. B — Say sorry and accept fair guidance
   We should be honest and accept correction.

12. A — The treasurer
   The treasurer handles and records money.

13. C — Linear
   Linear means in a line.

14. C — Buy their crops and take them to markets
   Traders buy from farmers and sell in towns.

15. B — Parents, grandparents and elders
   Culture is taught in families and communities.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: A drawing with N at the top, E on the right, S at the bottom and W on the left.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for neat drawing, 1 mark for N at top, 1 mark for E, S and W correct.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: To plan journeys and to know which counties are next to us. Accept sharing resources.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible reason.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Equality: one vote each. Freedom of expression: giving opinions in class. Majority rule: choosing a game by most votes. Award marks for each element and example.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct element with example, up to 5.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: An economic activity is work done to earn income or produce goods and services. Examples are farming and fishing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning, 1 mark for each example.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The larger number of votes, more than any other choice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for larger number, 1 mark for votes.
